runtime.runner: tools.verification_ai.fixtures_observe.FixtureRunner (runner.Runner with a fixture start; candidates / inputs / check / submit / policy hooks unchanged)
runtime.prefix: player 0 policy instance choose() returns the fixed Damage Swap and source / target while the prefix lasts; acceptance and history updates through the runner; policy RNG not used during the prefix
runtime.stop: player 0 accepted end_turn or use_attack, or the turn changed

classification.S3a_attack_no_prefix: unreachable_by_priority (control: attack chosen first, no Damage Swap)

S1_retreat_payable.note: 往復のあと、にげる（費用 2・超 2 枚）を払える。交代先のフーディンは超 3 でワザを使える

S2a_trainer_potion.note: 往復のあと、きずぐすりを使える（にげるはエネルギーがなく組み立てられない）

S2b_trainer_switch.note: 往復のあと、ポケモンいれかえを使える。交代先のフーディンは超 3 でワザを使える

S3a_attack_no_prefix.note: 対照: バトル場のフーディンがワザ（超 3）を使える。前置きなし（方策の順位で往復に入れるか）

S3b_attack_after_constructed_loop.note: 構築だけの対照: ワザがある場面で前置きの往復を固定する（方策の順位では到達しない前置き）

S4_improving_no_return.note: 9024 の番 23 の型: バトル場のダメージを 10 減らす 1 回の移動のあと、にげる（費用 3）→ エビワラーのジャブへ進める

S5_same_holder_other_move.note: 往復のあとも、同じ持ち主の別の移動（エビワラー → ディグダ）を組み立てられる。にげるは組み立てられない

S6a_retreat_unbuildable.note: 対照: 往復のあと、にげるを組み立てられない（エネルギーなし）。ほかの手がない

S5_probe_other_move.note: 同じ前置きのあと、別の移動（1 → 3）を前置きとして送り、受理と観測を確かめる

only_demoted_choice.reason: in the main phase the candidate list always starts with end_turn (kyuura_engine/legal_actions.py, MAIN), and end_turn is not suppressible; rank 7 can be the best only without end_turn
only_demoted_choice.demoted_candidate_kept_in_list: yes (S5 / S6a: use_power at rank 7 next to end_turn 6 when end_turn was chosen)

conclusions.valid_alternative_chosen: yes: payable retreat (S1, 4/4), Potion (S2a, 4/4), Switch then attack (S2b, 4/4) were chosen, built, checked and accepted after the demotion
conclusions.non_returning_move_kept: yes: the improving move (S4) was not demoted in 4/4; v2 and v3 made the same next choice in 4/4; in 2 seeds the policy's own uniform input then reversed it and v3 demoted only after that return
conclusions.valid_move_demoted: yes: S5, the same holder's other non-returning move (1 -> 3; accepted and not a return in the probe) is demoted with the holder key and v3 ended the turn in 4/4
conclusions.c2_c4: can proceed; Damage Swap exists only in C1 (both) and C3 (seat 1, L67-U), so C2 and C4 are expected to be identical controls; count end_turn choices with a demoted Damage Swap present
